proposals.evidence: CDIAL 7766 padga explicitly lists Gujarati pāg foot/leg and Hindi pag foot. These whole pag leg responses fit that family; Turner leaves single g and short a unexplained. A compound pagḍaṇḍi path needs separate components. Exact survey form pag is preserved; uncertain intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
